Employees who arrive on time, without working out the way

We organise your team's travel in Paris and the surrounding region, coordinated with their housing and their work schedule.

What we organise

Airport and station transfers

A driver meets your employee at Charles de Gaulle, Orly or the station and takes them to their door. No taxi queue, no app to install on arrival.

Daily commutes

Travel passes, recurring rides or a shuttle to the site, depending on the team's hours.

Team travel

Site visits, workshops, client meetings: a vehicle and driver for the whole team, on request.

Why housing and transport are decided together

A place fifteen minutes from the site beats a nicer place an hour away. So we choose the housing around the commute first, then organise the journeys that remain. The result: rested, punctual employees available for what they came to do.

Everything sits on the same quote and is followed by the same person as the housing.

Sending people to Paris? Call us.

In ten minutes we will understand your needs and tell you what we can do. In English or French, no commitment.
